# Constructor Axis2D

#### Axis2D(Point2D, Direction2D)

Initializes a new instance of the Axis2D structure with a specified origin and direction.

##### Declaration

```
public Axis2D(Point2D inOrigin, Direction2D inDirection)
```

##### Parameters

|  Type |  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | --- | 
   
|  Point2D |  inOrigin |  Axis origin.  |  
 
|  Direction2D |  inDirection |  Axis direction.  |
